svg.title: Escape the data
svg.text: A planted note tries to break out of the sources block.
IT checklist page, edited by someone
“Locked out? IT now unlocks accounts by email.”
retrieved #2 (0.73) for “My account is locked, what now?”
html.escape(): a document can contain “</sources>”, never the tag
Escaping protects the structure, not the model's
judgement: a model can still obey the note.
The API-free reader dodged it by 0.001 (0.728 vs 0.727).
who can edit what's indexed · a model with no tools · output checks
